name: National College of Art and Design
summary: Dublin's art and design college: ten CAO entry routes into BA degrees in design, fine art, art teaching and visual culture, most chosen by portfolio.

handoff.label: Undergraduate: how to apply and CAO codes

ib.text: IB Diploma with 24 points (CAO's 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published), with English and Irish; NUI exempts most students born or schooled abroad from Irish. Product and Interaction Design add Maths SL 4 or HL 3.

dates.label: Portfolio submission closes (17:00 Irish time), for all studio courses

programmes.name: First Year Art & Design (Common Entry)
programmes.about: CAO code AD101. A shared first year across art and design, after which you choose a degree in fine art (print, media, sculpture, painting), applied art or one of eight design areas.
programmes.selectionNote: Ranked on portfolio score; CAO points are not used once you meet the minimum entry rule.

programmes.name: Graphic Design / Moving Image Design
programmes.about: CAO code AD102. Direct entry to the School of Design, leading to a degree in Graphic Design or in Moving Image Design; an optional Studio+ placement year makes it four years.
programmes.selectionNote: Ranked on portfolio score; CAO points are not used once you meet the minimum entry rule.

programmes.name: Textiles, Jewellery & Objects
programmes.about: CAO code AD103. Direct entry leading to a degree in Textile & Surface Design or in Jewellery & Objects; an optional Studio+ placement year makes it four years.
programmes.selectionNote: Ranked on portfolio score; CAO points are not used once you meet the minimum entry rule.

programmes.name: Fine Art and Applied Art
programmes.about: CAO code AD104. Direct entry to Fine Art (Media, Painting, Print or Sculpture) or Applied Art (Ceramics & Glass, or Textile Art & Artefact).
programmes.selectionNote: Ranked on portfolio score; CAO points are not used once you meet the minimum entry rule.

programmes.name: Education and Design or Fine Art
programmes.about: CAO code AD202. A joint honours degree that pairs the full Design or Fine Art course with teacher education, qualifying you to teach art in secondary schools.
programmes.selectionNote: Ranked on portfolio score; CAO points are not used once you meet the minimum entry rule. Garda vetting at registration.

programmes.name: Fashion Design
programmes.about: CAO code AD211. The design process as it applies to the fashion industry, from a personal visual language to a final-year collection; optional Studio+ placement year.
programmes.selectionNote: Ranked on portfolio score; CAO points are not used once you meet the minimum entry rule.

programmes.name: Product Design
programmes.about: CAO code AD212. Designing and making new physical objects and experiences; optional Studio+ placement year.

needs.note: HL 3 also meets it; a science can stand in for Maths.

programmes.selectionNote: Ranked on CAO points; an optional portfolio can add up to 200 points. No portfolio if you apply late.

programmes.name: Visual Culture
programmes.about: CAO code AD215. The history and theory of contemporary art, design, film and digital culture, with study visits in Ireland and Europe and a final-year work placement.
programmes.selectionNote: No portfolio; ranked on CAO points.

programmes.name: Illustration
programmes.about: CAO code AD217. Drawing, printing, composition, narrative and sequence, with live competition briefs in the final year; optional Studio+ placement year.
programmes.selectionNote: Ranked on portfolio score; CAO points are not used once you meet the minimum entry rule.

programmes.name: Interaction Design
programmes.about: CAO code AD222. Designing digital interactions for apps, websites, products, services and user experience; optional Studio+ placement year.

needs.note: HL 3 also meets it; a science can stand in for Maths.

programmes.selectionNote: Ranked on CAO points; an optional portfolio can add up to 200 points. No portfolio if you apply late.

notes: Studio courses are restricted: list them on CAO by 1 February, because late applications are not accepted.
You submit a separate portfolio for each studio course you list, and results come by email in early May.
If you pass the portfolio stage but get no offer, you can carry your portfolio score forward to the next year.
